card.name: Linking words in reproductive-risk counseling
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "to" and "and" in counseling sentences about females or males of reproductive potential, contraception, and fetal risk. It fires on the word right before the contraception or fetus phrase.

modes.label: "to" before contraception or fetus
modes.description: The word "to" after "reproductive potential" or "potential risk", just before "use" or "a fetus".
modes.example: Advise males with female partners of reproductive potential<< to>> use condoms during treatment with nelarab

modes.label: Other links near contraception
modes.description: A comma or "and" near contraception or hazard-warning text, just before a continuing list.
